quiz.question_id: Apa perbedaan inti antara value receiver dan pointer receiver?
quiz.question_en: What is the core difference between a value receiver and a pointer receiver?
options_id: Value receiver bekerja pada salinan, pointer receiver dapat memodifikasi nilai asli
Pointer receiver selalu lebih cepat tanpa pengecualian
Value receiver hanya untuk struct kecil dengan 2 field
Tidak ada perbedaan perilaku
options_en: A value receiver works on a copy, while a pointer receiver can modify the original value
A pointer receiver is always faster with no exceptions
A value receiver is only for small structs with 2 fields
There is no behavioral difference

quiz.question_id: Mengapa `Area()` pada `Rectangle` cocok memakai value receiver dalam lesson?
quiz.question_en: Why is `Area()` on `Rectangle` a good fit for a value receiver in the lesson?
options_id: Karena method itu hanya membaca data dan tidak perlu mengubah receiver
Karena value receiver wajib dipakai untuk semua method matematika
Karena pointer receiver tidak bisa mengembalikan `float64`
Karena `Rectangle` bukan struct
options_en: Because the method only reads data and does not need to mutate the receiver
Because value receivers are mandatory for all mathematical methods
Because pointer receivers cannot return `float64`
Because `Rectangle` is not a struct

quiz.question_id: Mengapa `Increment()` pada `Counter` harus memakai pointer receiver agar efektif?
quiz.question_en: Why must `Increment()` on `Counter` use a pointer receiver to be effective?
options_id: Karena hanya pointer receiver yang boleh mengakses field private
Karena method itu harus mengubah state `count` milik receiver asli, bukan salinannya
Karena `++` tidak valid pada value receiver
Karena pointer receiver diperlukan untuk semua method tanpa return value
options_en: Because only pointer receivers may access private fields
Because the method must mutate the original receiver's `count` state rather than a copy
Because `++` is invalid on a value receiver
Because pointer receivers are required for all methods without return values

quiz.question_id: Mengapa lesson menyarankan konsistensi jika satu method pada tipe memakai pointer receiver?
quiz.question_en: Why does the lesson recommend consistency if one method on a type uses a pointer receiver?
options_id: Agar method set dan ekspektasi pemakaian tipe lebih konsisten dan tidak membingungkan
Karena compiler menolak campuran receiver
Karena semua value receiver menjadi panic jika dicampur
Karena pointer receiver satu-satunya yang bisa dipanggil dari interface
options_en: So the method set and the expectations for using the type stay consistent and less confusing
Because the compiler rejects mixed receiver kinds
Because all value receivers panic if mixed
Because pointer receivers are the only ones callable from interfaces

quiz.question_id: Dalam kasus apa Go bisa mengizinkan pemanggilan `person.Birthday()` walau `Birthday` memakai pointer receiver?
quiz.question_en: In what case can Go allow calling `person.Birthday()` even though `Birthday` has a pointer receiver?
options_id: Saat `person` adalah variabel addressable sehingga Go bisa mengambil alamatnya otomatis
Hanya saat `person` berada di package yang sama
Hanya saat method tidak mengubah field
Tidak pernah; harus selalu menulis `(&person).Birthday()`
options_en: When `person` is an addressable variable so Go can automatically take its address
Only when `person` is in the same package
Only when the method does not mutate fields
Never; you must always write `(&person).Birthday()`

quiz.question_id: Mengapa pointer receiver sering dipilih untuk struct besar meskipun method hanya membaca?
quiz.question_en: Why is a pointer receiver often chosen for a large struct even if the method only reads?
options_id: Untuk menghindari penyalinan nilai struct besar pada setiap pemanggilan method
Karena value receiver tidak bisa mengakses field struct besar
Karena pointer receiver membuat semua method inline
Karena hasil return jadi lebih akurat
options_en: To avoid copying a large struct value on every method call
Because value receivers cannot access fields of large structs
Because pointer receivers make all methods inline
Because the return value becomes more accurate

quiz.question_id: Apa yang ditunjukkan oleh method pada `type Celsius float64`?
quiz.question_en: What is demonstrated by methods on `type Celsius float64`?
options_id: Method di Go hanya bisa ada pada struct anonim
Method dapat didefinisikan pada named type yang dideklarasikan di package yang sama, tidak hanya struct
Float64 bawaan otomatis punya semua method temperatur
Method pada non-struct harus selalu pointer receiver
options_en: Methods in Go can only exist on anonymous structs
Methods can be defined on named types declared in the same package, not just on structs
Built-in float64 automatically has all temperature methods
Methods on non-struct types must always use pointer receivers

quiz.question_id: Pada starter code, mengapa `Scale` pada `Rectangle` memakai pointer receiver?
quiz.question_en: In the starter code, why does `Scale` on `Rectangle` use a pointer receiver?
options_id: Karena ia perlu mengubah `Width` dan `Height` milik rectangle asli
Karena method dengan parameter harus pointer receiver
Karena value receiver tidak bisa mengalikan float
Karena `Scale` mengembalikan string
options_en: Because it needs to mutate the original rectangle's `Width` and `Height`
Because methods with parameters must use pointer receivers
Because value receivers cannot multiply floats
Because `Scale` returns a string

quiz.question_id: Pernyataan mana yang paling akurat tentang pemilihan receiver?
quiz.question_en: Which statement is most accurate about choosing a receiver kind?
options_id: Selalu gunakan pointer receiver tanpa mempertimbangkan semantik
Pilih receiver berdasarkan apakah method perlu mutasi, ukuran tipe, dan konsistensi API
Selalu gunakan value receiver kecuali compiler menolak
Receiver tidak berpengaruh pada desain method sama sekali
options_en: Always use a pointer receiver without considering semantics
Choose the receiver based on whether the method needs mutation, the type size, and API consistency
Always use a value receiver unless the compiler rejects it
The receiver has no effect on method design at all
